description: Record-precise Machine Snapshot. Telemetry panels show only ldi_data; alarm panels show only ldi_alarm_log joined to the verified master. Alarm-only machines are explicitly labeled rather than receiving invented telemetry values.

panels.description: The table keeps every telemetry record from the selected machine and minute. Clicking a blue Timestamp changes only the exact-record detail panels below; it does not collapse this table to one row.

value.title: Update detail panels and keep all records in this minute

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "time" AS "Timestamp", eqp_id AS "Machine", state AS "State", mo AS "MO", fpn AS "FPN", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Board", filmno AS "Film", resist AS "Resist", scale_mode AS "Scale Mode", factory AS "Factory", log_id AS "Log ID"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE (
  ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
  AND eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
  AND "time" >= date_bin('1 minute', to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC / 1000.0), TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01')
  AND "time" < date_bin('1 minute', to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC / 1000.0), TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01') + INTERVAL '1 minute'
) OR (
  ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0
  AND log_id = NULLIF(${validated_log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
) OR (
  ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0
  AND ${validated_log_id:sqlstring} = '__none__'
  AND log_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (d0.eqp_id) d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE d0.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
      AND d0.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
      AND $__timeFilter(d0."time")
    ORDER BY d0.eqp_id, d0."time" DESC
  )
)
ORDER BY "time" ASC

panels.description: Real PE values from the selected event. N/A means this machine/event did not provide PE data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(pe_1::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_1",ROUND(pe_2::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_2",
 ROUND(pe_3::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_3",ROUND(pe_4::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_4",
 ROUND(pe_5::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_5",ROUND(pe_6::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_6",
 ROUND(max_pe::NUMERIC,3) AS "MAX|PE|",ROUND(pe_setting::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_setting",
 CASE WHEN max_pe IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN max_pe <= pe_setting THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'OUT OF SPEC' END AS "PE Status"
FROM (
 SELECT d.*,GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) AS max_pe
 FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE log_id=(COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  NULLIF(${validated_log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
)) LIMIT 1
) event_row;

panels.description: Process capability from v_machine_spc_ranking. Cpk >= 1.33 = Capable, Sigma Level = Cpk * 3.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_machines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE ((${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0 AND eqp_id=split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring},' - ',1))
    OR (${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})))
), pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id,d.pe_setting,p.pe FROM public.ldi_data d JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id=d.eqp_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time") AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id,COUNT(*) sample_count,AVG(pe) mean_pe,STDDEV_SAMP(pe) stddev_pe,AVG(pe_setting) lim FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
)
SELECT sm.eqp_id AS "Machine",COALESCE(stats.sample_count,0) AS "Samples",ROUND(stats.mean_pe::NUMERIC,2) AS "Mean PE",
 ROUND((lim/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0))::NUMERIC,2) AS "Cp",
 ROUND(LEAST((lim-mean_pe)/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0),(mean_pe+lim)/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0))::NUMERIC,2) AS "Cpk"
FROM selected_machines sm LEFT JOIN stats ON stats.eqp_id=sm.eqp_id;

panels.description: Alarm rows within ±5 minutes of the exact selected telemetry record. This panel stays empty until a Timestamp is selected in STEP 1.

targets.rawSql:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)
    ELSE (
      SELECT d."time"
      FROM public.ldi_data d
      WHERE d.log_id = NULLIF(${validated_log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
      LIMIT 1
    )
  END AS "time"
),
all_machines AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.factory::TEXT AS factory, d.process::TEXT AS process
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.equipmentid, a.factory::TEXT, a.process::TEXT
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  WHERE a.equipmentid IS NOT NULL
),
selected_machines AS (
  SELECT
    am.eqp_id,
    MIN(am.factory) AS factory,
    MIN(am.process) AS process
  FROM all_machines am
  WHERE (
      ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND am.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    )
    OR (
      ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0
      AND am.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    )
  GROUP BY am.eqp_id
),
alarm_rows AS (
  SELECT
    al.logid,
    al.logdate,
    al.errorcode,
    al.errortime,
    al.equipmentid,
    al.factory,
    al.process,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_id, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_id,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED') AS alarm_type,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_code, al.errorcode::TEXT) AS alarm_code,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, al.errorcode::TEXT) AS alarm_msg,
    CASE
      WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'No master record for this errorcode'
      ELSE COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, 'No detail provided in master')
    END AS alarm_detail,
    CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END AS mapping_status
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log al
  JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id = al.equipmentid
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m
    ON al.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
  WHERE al.logdate BETWEEN
      (SELECT "time" - INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target)
      AND
      (SELECT "time" + INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target)
)
SELECT *
FROM alarm_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'NO-ALARM-' || sm.eqp_id,
  target."time",
  NULL::TEXT,
  NULL::TEXT,
  sm.eqp_id,
  sm.factory,
  sm.process,
  'NOT APPLICABLE',
  'NO ALARM',
  'NOT APPLICABLE',
  'No alarm event within ±5 minutes',
  'Telemetry exists at the selected point, but no alarm event exists for this machine in the ±5-minute window',
  'NO ALARM'
FROM selected_machines sm
CROSS JOIN target
WHERE target."time" IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM alarm_rows ar
  WHERE ar.equipmentid = sm.eqp_id
)
ORDER BY logdate DESC, equipmentid

panels.title: Alarm Context ±5 min — ldi_alarm_log + Master

panels.description: All telemetry and alarm events in the selected ±5-minute context. No SQL row limit is applied; pagination controls rendering.

targets.rawSql:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)
    ELSE (
      SELECT d."time"
      FROM public.ldi_data d
      WHERE d.log_id = NULLIF(${validated_log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
      LIMIT 1
    )
  END AS t
),
events AS (
  SELECT
    d."time" AS event_time,
    d.eqp_id AS machine,
    'STATE'::TEXT AS event_type,
    'ldi_data'::TEXT AS source,
    d.log_id::TEXT AS logid,
    NULL::TEXT AS errorcode,
    NULL::TEXT AS errortime,
    d.factory::TEXT AS factory,
    d.process::TEXT AS process,
    'NOT APPLICABLE'::TEXT AS alarm_id,
    'TELEMETRY'::TEXT AS alarm_type,
    'NOT APPLICABLE'::TEXT AS alarm_code,
    'State sample; no alarm event'::TEXT AS alarm_msg,
    'Alarm fields apply only to ALARM rows'::TEXT AS alarm_detail,
    'NOT APPLICABLE'::TEXT AS mapping_status,
    CASE WHEN d.state THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS description
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN target
  WHERE (
      (${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
        AND d.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1))
      OR
      (${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0
        AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
    )
    AND d."time" BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
                     AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    a.logdate,
    a.equipmentid,
    'ALARM',
    'ldi_alarm_log',
    a.logid,
    a.errorcode::TEXT,
    a.errortime::TEXT,
    a.factory::TEXT,
    a.process::TEXT,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_id, 'UNMAPPED'),
    COALESCE(m.alarm_type, 'UNMAPPED'),
    COALESCE(m.alarm_code, a.errorcode::TEXT),
    COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode::TEXT),
    CASE
      WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'No master record for this errorcode'
      ELSE COALESCE(m.alarm_detail, 'No detail provided in master')
    END,
    CASE WHEN m.alarm_code IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END,
    COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode::TEXT)
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m
    ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT
  CROSS JOIN target
  WHERE (
      (${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
        AND a.equipmentid = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1))
      OR
      (${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0
        AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
    )
    AND a.logdate BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
                      AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
)
SELECT
  event_time AS "Event Time",
  machine AS "Machine",
  event_type AS "Event Type",
  source AS "Source",
  description AS "Description",
  mapping_status,
  logid,
  errorcode,
  errortime,
  factory,
  process,
  alarm_id,
  alarm_type,
  alarm_code,
  alarm_msg,
  alarm_detail
FROM events
ORDER BY event_time DESC

list.definition:
WITH options AS (
  SELECT
    '__select__'::TEXT AS __text,
    '__select__'::TEXT AS __value,
    0 AS sort_rank,
    NOW() AS sort_time
  WHERE ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    '__auto__'::TEXT AS __text,
    '__auto__'::TEXT AS __value,
    0 AS sort_rank,
    NOW() AS sort_time
  WHERE ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    log_id::TEXT AS __text,
    log_id::TEXT AS __value,
    1 AS sort_rank,
    "time" AS sort_time
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0
    AND cardinality(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::TEXT[]) = 1
    AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter("time")
)
SELECT __text, __value
FROM options
ORDER BY sort_rank, sort_time DESC
LIMIT 501

list.definition:
WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT
    d.log_id::TEXT AS __text,
    d.log_id::TEXT AS __value
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  WHERE ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0
    AND cardinality(ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}]::TEXT[]) = 1
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.log_id::TEXT = NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__select__')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT '__auto__'::TEXT, '__auto__'::TEXT
  WHERE ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
)
SELECT __text, __value FROM candidate
UNION ALL
SELECT '__none__', '__none__'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate)
